orderPolicyHtml:
• Please check the product in front of the delivery person before paying.
  • If the product is damaged, wrong or a different colour / size / model, tell us within 3 days of delivery and we will replace it free of charge.
  • Change-of-mind returns are accepted within 3 days if the product is unused and in its original box; the customer pays the return delivery charge.
  • If you refuse a parcel without a valid reason, the delivery charge must be paid to the rider.
